replacementRecipes.pricing-ranges: Explain that price depends on measured roof area, access, pitch, assembly, material, and discovered conditions; invite a written scope without publishing an unsupported range.
replacementRecipes.exact-response-or-availability: Offer phone and scheduling options without promising 24/7 coverage, exact travel time, or a universal response window.
replacementRecipes.universal-permit-handling: Direct the homeowner to the municipality for current requirements and state that permit responsibility must be confirmed in the written project scope.
replacementRecipes.unverified-insurance-credentials: Retain the verified Utah DOPL license and BBB accreditation only. Do not publish general-liability or workers-compensation assertions until current evidence is registered.
replacementRecipes.universal-project-duration: State that timing is confirmed after roof assembly, scope, access, weather, material availability, and permit requirements are known.
replacementRecipes.unsourced-roof-life-or-hail-frequency: Describe observable conditions and link to primary weather or municipal sources; do not quantify citywide frequency or years of life lost without registered evidence.
replacementRecipes.unverified-city-project-or-review-attrib: Use non-project neighborhood and jurisdiction context. A review or image may be attributed to a city only when the private project record or public review itself establishes that city.
